exercises.title: Greet yourself
exercises.description: Write a function `greet(name)` that returns a greeting message. For example, if you call `greet("Ada")`, it should return "Hello, Ada!"

exercises.title: Share your favorite number
exercises.description: Create a function `favorite_number(name, number)` that returns a sentence about your favorite number. For example, `favorite_number("Ada", 7)` should return "Ada's favorite number is 7."
